sources.title: Native Runtimes
sources.observed_contract: The tools list applies to all native runtimes and lists node, npm, yarn and pnpm as available during builds and at runtime.
sources.applicable_surface: secondary JavaScript tools in native Ruby build/runtime

sources.title: Deploy a Rails 6 or 7 App on Render
sources.observed_contract: The Rails guide uses Ruby with Node.js and Yarn dependencies; asset-oriented Rails applications need the secondary JavaScript toolchain.
sources.qualification: No full Rails application, gems, migration, database or paid pre-deploy is run by this probe.
